title: Kit Review (2026)
intro: Kit is evaluated here as email marketing software — Kit (formerly ConvertKit) is a creator-first email marketing platform for newsletters, visual automations, landing pages/forms, and digital product selling. Pricing is subscriber-tiered: Newsletter free (limited automations), Creator from $33/mo and Pro from $66/mo at 1,000 subscribers on monthly billing (annual discounts published). This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s email-marketing methodology (ease of use, email creation, automation, segmentation, analytics, deliverability tooling, integrations, scalability, value, AI). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Kit when creator/newsletter email with landing pages and monetization is the primary job (including ConvertKit migrations).
verdict: Choose Kit when creator/newsletter email with landing pages and monetization is the primary job (including ConvertKit migrations). Compare Flodesk for design-led creator email, Beehiiv for newsletter growth platforms, MailerLite for simpler free-tier SMB email, and Omnisend/Klaviyo for ecommerce. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.

faq.question: Is Kit a full email marketing ESP?
faq.answer: Yes. Kit is evaluated as email marketing / ESP software for campaigns, lists, and related automation — not as a full sales CRM of record.

faq.question: How is Kit priced?
faq.answer: Newsletter free (limited automations). Creator from $33/mo and Pro from $66/mo at 1,000 subscribers (monthly; annual discounts). 14-day trial. Confirm live slider.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test Kit?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage.
